measures.name: Share of population age 65 and over

variables.name: Total population
variables.description: Residents counted at their usual place of residence.

variables.name: Median age
variables.description: The age that divides the population into two equal groups.

variables.name: Population under age 18
variables.description: Residents younger than 18.

variables.name: Population age 65 and over
variables.description: Residents aged 65 or older.

variables.name: Median household income
variables.description: Median of annual household income, in 2024 inflation-adjusted dollars. Households are the universe, not people.

variables.name: Poverty rate
variables.description: Share of people for whom poverty status is determined whose income in the past 12 months was below the poverty level.

variables.name: Median gross rent
variables.description: Median monthly rent plus utilities, in 2024 inflation-adjusted dollars, for renter-occupied units paying cash rent.

variables.name: Rent burden rate
variables.description: Share of renter households paying 30 percent or more of household income on rent. Renter households where the share is not computed are counted in the denominator, so this reads slightly lower than the Census's own published percentage, which leaves them out.

variables.name: Disability rate
variables.description: Share of the civilian noninstitutionalized population with a disability.

variables.name: Households without internet access rate
variables.description: Share of households with no internet access, with or without a subscription.

variables.name: Population for whom poverty status is determined
variables.description: People in the universe of the poverty rate. It leaves out, for example, people in institutions and college dormitories.

variables.name: Renter households
variables.description: Renter-occupied housing units.

variables.name: Civilian noninstitutionalized population
variables.description: People in the universe of the disability rate.

variables.name: Total households
variables.description: Occupied housing units.

variables.name: Average household size
variables.description: Average number of people in an occupied housing unit.

variables.name: Share of population under age 18
variables.description: Share of residents younger than 18.

variables.name: Share of population age 65 and over
variables.description: Share of residents aged 65 or older.

variables.name: Foreign-born rate
variables.description: Share of residents born outside the United States.

variables.name: Veteran rate
variables.description: Share of civilian adults who are veterans.

variables.name: Limited English speaking households rate
variables.description: Share of households in which no one 14 and over speaks English only or speaks English very well.

variables.name: Per capita income
variables.description: Mean income per person in the past 12 months, in 2024 inflation-adjusted dollars.

variables.name: Child poverty rate
variables.description: Share of people under 18 for whom poverty status is determined whose income in the past 12 months was below the poverty level.

variables.name: Senior poverty rate
variables.description: Share of people 65 and over for whom poverty status is determined whose income in the past 12 months was below the poverty level.

variables.name: Housing units
variables.description: Occupied and vacant housing units.

variables.name: Homeownership rate
variables.description: Share of occupied housing units that are owner-occupied.

variables.name: Vacancy rate
variables.description: Share of housing units that are vacant.

variables.name: Median home value
variables.description: Median value of owner-occupied housing units, as the owner estimates it, in 2024 inflation-adjusted dollars.

variables.name: Owner cost burden rate
variables.description: Share of owner households paying 30 percent or more of household income on housing costs.

variables.name: Overcrowding rate
variables.description: Share of occupied housing units with more than 1 occupant per room.

variables.name: Broadband subscription rate
variables.description: Share of households with a broadband internet subscription of any type.

variables.name: Households without a computer rate
variables.description: Share of households with no computer, smartphone or tablet.

variables.name: Work-from-home rate
variables.description: Share of workers 16 and over who worked from home.

variables.name: Public transit commute rate
variables.description: Share of workers 16 and over who commuted by public transportation.

variables.name: Households without a vehicle rate
variables.description: Share of households with no vehicle available.

variables.name: Labor force participation rate
variables.description: Share of people 16 and over who are in the labor force.

variables.name: Unemployment rate
variables.description: Share of the civilian labor force that is unemployed.

variables.name: Population in the nativity universe
variables.description: People in the universe of the foreign-born rate.

variables.name: Civilian population 18 and over
variables.description: People in the universe of the veteran rate.

variables.name: Households by language status
variables.description: Households in the universe of the limited English speaking rate.

variables.name: Population under 18 for whom poverty status is determined
variables.description: People under 18 in the universe of the child poverty rate.

variables.name: Population 65 and over for whom poverty status is determined
variables.description: People 65 and over in the universe of the senior poverty rate.

variables.name: Occupied housing units
variables.description: Occupied housing units in the universe of the homeownership rate.

variables.name: Owner-occupied housing units
variables.description: Owner-occupied units in the universe of the owner cost burden rate.

variables.name: Occupied housing units by occupants per room
variables.description: Occupied housing units in the universe of the overcrowding rate.

variables.name: Households by computer access
variables.description: Households in the universe of the no-computer rate.

variables.name: Workers 16 and over
variables.description: Workers in the universe of the commute rates.

variables.name: Households by vehicles available
variables.description: Households in the universe of the no-vehicle rate.

variables.name: Population 16 and over
variables.description: People in the universe of the labor force participation rate.

variables.name: Civilian labor force
variables.description: People in the universe of the unemployment rate.
